name: hybrid-ablation-v1
evidence_class: procedurally held-out synthetic scenes; not real-world accuracy validation

decision.primary_improvement: All 24 primary scenes must be rankable in both combined and Doppler-only. Both the paired mean error difference and difference of marginal medians (combined minus doppler_only) must have a 95% paired scene-bootstrap upper bound below zero, and all-case 500 m success cannot decrease. Other comparisons are descriptive, not multiple-testing-controlled claims.
decision.deployment: No automatic fusion or real-world accuracy claim from synthetic results; inspect mismatch and wrong-association harm before changing defaults.

constraints: Change only three term-enable booleans between modes; same candidate order, observations, associations, clock, heights, emitted frequencies, scales and weights.
Default combined weighting is two Doppler terms and one thunder term, not equal modality weights.
Independent Python analytic ECEF source/receiver oracle; production Rust physics never generates observations or truth.
All input and truth files and code hashes are frozen before development predictions; no threshold, scenario or seed changes after held-out results.
Score input contains opaque case IDs, not evaluation family, split, seed or receiver truth. Predictions are committed before the evaluator opens truth.
Off-grid truth and grid center are randomized independently; the same 625 candidate coordinates are used for every mode.
Primary analysis uses 24 independent nominal/noisy holdouts. Ambiguity, model mismatch and 32 correlated control variants are separate strata.
Report unavailable modes and all-case success denominators; paired error analysis alone cannot conceal missing results.
Production outputs remain unverified and uncalibrated. Low-score wrong winners are diagnostics, not false-confidence estimates.
This evaluates scoring with supplied reviewed measurements and associations, not audio detection, association discovery, clock estimation or global search.
